ammonia.reason: Minimal deamination of amino acids in unripened pasta-filata curd.

animal_barnyard.reason: No washed-rind Brevibacterium; no p-cresol/indole accumulation.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic peptides due to short age and stretched washed curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; no C7-C11 methyl ketones.

browning.reason: Residual lactose plus protein drives Maillard plus caramel smoked rind.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus starter diacetyl/acetoin plus milk-fat C4-C12 lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipolysis in 2-week age; low butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 25% fat at 50.9% moisture lubricates without crystals.

crumbliness.reason: Aligned stretched casein fibers deform rather than fracture.

firmness.reason: Pasta-filata knit at ~51% moisture gives elastic semi-firm body.

fruity.reason: Limited esterase activity in young curd; little ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Very short ripening limits Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal formation.

melt.reason: De-mineralized pH 5.5 para-casein flows readily when heated.

oil_off.reason: Free milkfat from 25% fat coalesces on heating with limited emulsification.

smoky.reason: Wood pyrolysis deposits guaiacol/syringol/phenols on rind and paste.

sour_vinegar.reason: Starter lactic acid to pH 5.5 with trace acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Hot-stretched oriented casein network forms long fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Hot-water stretching denatures whey protein releasing H2S/methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus caramelized smoke notes.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from brief rennet proteolysis.
